title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-07
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > CDWAV > Cool Edit Pro Noise Filter > SHN > CDR

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture of a high‑energy ’69 show with a smoking Dark Star, The Other One → Lovelight segue and an intense Good Lovin’ jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard mix that sounds great for its era, with only a minor cut in the middle of Dark Star. Musically the performance is high‑octane – Dark Star (with a pre‑Slipknot riff), an explosive Hard to Handle, a soaring Good Lovin’ jam and the classic Other One → Lovelight transition are repeatedly highlighted by reviewers.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.6/5; most comments praise both the musical energy and the soundboard quality, with only minor criticisms about sloppiness or a brief cut.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally great vintage soundboard mix; crisp for the time with a slight audience bleed and a painful cut in Dark Star, but overall clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow with notable segues (Other One into Lovelight) and continuous jams; reviewers appreciate the energy build through Dark Star into Good Lovin'.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pig on organ noted on both The Other One and Lovelight, providing solid keyboard texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Wailing drums highlighted as a powerful component of the performance.
